note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: The Sharing tab moves into the shared UI kit (cinatra#3385): the permissions panel, the access combobox and the containment and scope readings a connector's sharing surface draws now live in packages/sdk-ui, where an extension that draws its own page can adopt the same tab, instead of in the app tree where only the host could reach them. MEASURED, NOT ARGUED, in one environment by scripts/route-graph.mjs on this branch with main merged in (main at edf725b1a5c496f4dbe816c0e768964e1024c7c5) and the companion extension fleet cloned pinned at the merged tree's lock files (116/116, missingCount 0 on every route), and attributed module by module by diffing the two reachable sets: six kit modules enter every one of the four graphs (packages/sdk-ui/src/access-combobox.tsx, access/containment.ts, access/scope.ts, lib/access-visibility.ts, ui/command.tsx and ui/tooltip.tsx) and four app modules leave them (src/components/access-containment.ts, access-scope.ts, ui/command.tsx and ui/popover.tsx), so the growth is NOT purely additive: four of the six are the kit twins of the four that leave, and the net +2 is the visibility reading and the tooltip primitive the kit's panel draws. main's committed ceilings are 1791, 1893, 1799 and 1809 for /api/mcp, /chat, /api/a2a and /api/llm-bridge, the merged tree measures 1793, 1895, 1801 and 1811, so this route moves 1799 -> 1801 and nothing of main's is folded into this raise. NARROWING IS UNAVAILABLE at this size: the kit is reachable from all four routes through the host's connector surfaces by construction, the analyzer counts a dynamic import() specifier as the same graph pressure as a static one, and folding the two new leaves into the panel module would hide the count without removing a byte from the graph. /sign-in reaches none of it and keeps its committed ceiling and its own record untouched. The records main carries for these four routes (cinatra#3414) are retired by this raise, the one lifecycle the gate allows for an annotation whose ceiling moves.
